title: Oracle Midday Brief

**ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin's up nearly five percent in twenty-four hours, breaking through $66,800 as institutional demand picks up momentum. That's the headline.

But here's what matters: Fear and Greed sits at extreme fear—20. That's capitulation territory. When retail panics this hard, smart money typically steps in. The hashrate holding steady at 913 exahashes signals miner confidence despite the sentiment disconnect.
